title: A Veil for the Wolf Anew
author: Odile Galloway
blurb: Lena Winterbourne, a cartographer of unmapped realms, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
